children: ONE Nuclear Energy completed its SPAC business combination and will commence Nasdaq trading under the ticker ONEN.
Closed business combination with Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII and renamed the combined company ONE Nuclear Energy.
New ONE Nuclear common stock expected to begin trading on Nasdaq on or about Sept. 24, 2026 under ticker ONEN.
Presentation by CEO Richard Taylor at the Nuclear Innovation Summit furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to the Form 8-K.
Holders redeemed 13,809,029 Class A shares for ~ $10.61 each, totaling ~ $146.5 million, leaving ~ $2.2 million in trust pre-expenses.
Combined platform launches with a 5 GW Louisiana development portfolio spanning SMR nuclear, natural gas and 700 MW/2.88 GWh BESS projects.
